blurb:
Put the spandex away. Tomorrow is a **rest day**, and our model gives you a measly 26.6% chance of actually sweating. 

Here is why your couch is calling your name:

*   **Rain, rain, go away:** Precipitation is forecasted for 37.5% of tomorrow’s hours—way wetter than your usual 8.3%. Turns out getting waterboarded by the sky is hurting your training vibes.
*   **Too hot to trot:** Your forecast low is 10.34 °F *warmer* than normal for this time of year (sitting at a toasty anomaly), and your high is 55.4 °F with a high that's also 6.47 °F above normal. Apparently, Mother Nature decided to turn up the dial just enough to ruin your motivation.
*   **The couch potato legacy:** You’re sitting on a 28-day fitness base of 18.81 effort points/day, but you haven't touched a hard effort in a whopping 23 days. Shocking, I know. 

Sure, your historical weekday hustle (you train 34% of the time on this particular day) and your 18.52 miles/day mileage base tried to save you, but the weather and your own sudden aversion to hard work dragged this prediction straight into hibernation. Enjoy the rest day—you've apparently earned a 23-day vacation from trying hard.
